content: {"praised":["Returns to original setting with familiar characters.","Campy action and humor make it entertaining.","Improved CGI compared to earlier films.","Cult status appreciated by fans.","Classic monster theme remains engaging."],"criticized":["Special effects are poor and blocky.","Pacing is slow and unengaging.","Story feels elementary and predictable.","Characters lack depth, especially Burt Gummer.","Overall quality considered the worst in series."]}
